about_the_game: William is a shooter who lived in the Middle Ages. He will leave a cell located in the center of the castle and go to the target area located in a forest area outside the castle. However, the roads he can use to go to the target area are surrounded by fences. There is no way to go outside the fences. For these reasons, he has to pass through houses and taverns. He also has to pass through large water channels located inside and outside the castle. William must not touch the water. When he touches it, he will lose all his life and the game will end. William will use vertical moving platforms to overcome the high walls of the castle and horizontal moving platforms to cross the water channels. However, William has 100 points of life at the beginning and 100 seconds to go to the target area. He loses 10 points of his life every time he touches an explosive. For this reason, William must constantly hit the target numbers that will appear in front of him and collect points and earn extra life and time. William will gain 10 lives and 3 seconds of time for every 1000 points he collects.6 levels must be completed before he can go from the cell to the target area. These levels are subject to sunny, rainy and snowy weather. One level is completed at night
